description: This file initializes the 'pipecat.services' module, defines a warning mechanism for deprecated modules, and implements a proxy class that triggers warnings upon deprecated module attribute accesses.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class that warns users when deprecated module attributes are accessed and redirects attribute access to the global dictionary.

methods.name: _warn_deprecated_access(globals: Dict[str, Any], attr, old: str, new: str)
methods.description: Issues a deprecation warning when an attribute from a deprecated module is accessed, ensuring the warning is only issued once per module pair.

methods.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the proxy with globals, old module name, and new module name.

methods.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy.__getattr__
methods.description: Handles attribute access, issuing warnings if necessary and retrieving the attribute from globals.

methods.name: __init__(self, globals: Dict[str, Any], old: str, new: str)
